scope.principle: Historical professor evaluations may inform an AI-authored editorial test, but they do not become present-tense professor opinions, endorsements, testimonials, or claims of current proficiency.

lenses.label: Margaret Morse lens preserves embodied and artistic intelligence
lenses.owner: Jamie Burkart with an independent editorial reviewer
historicalAnchors: early video equipment and media archaeology
time-based installation realized in a gallery
art and life joined through attention
dedication, warmth, and generosity in collaborative work
antiGaming: Do not reduce artistic, relational, or participatory work to organizational utility merely because utility is easier to hire for.
Do not add professor praise, grades, or evaluation text to the public site to make the gate pass.
Do not present this AI-authored lens as Margaret Morse's current opinion, authorship, review, or endorsement.
Do not use historical course performance as proof of current technical proficiency.
Do not flatten distinct artistic, civic, technical, and social projects into one continuous program.
lenses.stopRule: The automated gate passes when the portfolio system preserves embodied, artistic, relational, and place-based intelligence through existing public proof and explicit boundaries; the human gate remains open until an independent editor applies the lens to the current public site.
lenses.nextAction: Ask an independent editor to review the public site without private professor material and identify where hiring clarity erases or preserves experimentation, hospitality, atmosphere, attention, and embodied participation.

lenses.label: Warren Sack lens preserves recursive technical-social systems thinking
lenses.owner: Jamie Burkart with an independent technical-social-systems reviewer
historicalAnchors: recursive analysis of overlapping social groups
a working image-search prototype joining network and image analysis
an interactive Max/MSP and Jitter interface
physical traversal as an interface to online photographs
multimodal group documentation and classroom dialogue
antiGaming: Do not treat engagement totals as sufficient evidence of a social system, relationship model, or stakeholder response.
Do not publish the protected historical structural-equivalence observation as a current credential or priority technical claim.
Do not use historical course performance as proof of current tools, architecture, or implementation proficiency.
Do not erase group co-design, collaborators, or dialogue from technical accomplishment.
Do not satisfy the lens with a technology list that lacks relation, prototype, interface, documentation, and use context.
lenses.stopRule: The automated gate passes when recursive relations, implementation, interaction, documentation, and collective context can be traced through existing public proof; the human gate remains open until an independent reviewer tests the current public site.
lenses.nextAction: Ask an independent reviewer to trace one relationship model, one implementation, one interface or embodied interaction, one documentation system, and one collective-credit boundary from the public site alone.
